system.description:
Mark a Stress and roll a d6. The adversary uses the corresponding move:

1. Mana Beam: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 magic damage.

2. Fire Jets: Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the adversary succeeds against take 2d8 physical damage.

3. Dizzying Charge: Make an attack against all PCs within Close range. Targets the adversary succeeds against take 1d6+5 physical damage and are Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.

4. Shocking Gas: All targets within Close range must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or mark 3 Stress.

5. Stunning Clap: All targets within Very Close range must succeed on a Brawn Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable until the adversary is defeated.

6. Psionic Whine: All targets within Close range must succeed on a Charm Reaction Roll or take 2d4+9 direct magic damage.
